demos.name: Agent Registry Lifecycle
demos.description: Register an AI agent as a non-human identity, grant it to a tool, rotate it by replacement, retire it, and watch the gateway refuse it (401/403/429). Mock only.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 5010). Mock only: no tenant, no credentials. Docker: HOST_PORT=5010 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). composeFile is an absolute path on this machine; change it if the repo lives elsewhere.
